Equipment
 Over Voltage Relay 
 (59)
 TTG 7111
 CEE France

This procedure details the testing procedures and calibration I1, which 
 recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block.

The TTG 7111 has been designed for the protection 
 of Steam turbine Generators and the downstream users against the risk of 
 excessive over voltages.

The excessive over voltages may occur when large loads are suddenly removed or 
 when the A.V.R does not operate properly.

This relay shall be set at the maximum permissible operating voltage and time 
 delayed to allow transient over voltages, originated by sudden load shedding 
 to be adequately regulated by the excitation system.

The TTG 7111 Relay is supplied from a Voltage 
 Transformers (VT) providing secondary voltage to the relay.

The first draft initiated by Eng. Ehab El Khoudary, tested by Eng. Khalied 
 Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo Elwafa at 6 September 2008, and accepted by General 
 Manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby Head 
 Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category, 
 (safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc).

Issue work permit including the 
 team work name.

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

The unit (Generator & 
 Transformer) must be out of service.
Secondary Voltage injection test set.
Complete tool set.
Air blower.
Contact cleaner (CRC).

Look at Over Voltage Maintenance file (59) and compare the 
 relay setting with those shown on the test sheet.

Supply the relay with its nominal auxiliary supply: the green 
 LED will light.
Remove the terminals (10,11) from the relay.

Connect the voltage terminals from the injection set to the 
 relay points (10,11).
Increase the injected voltage slowly till the pickup value.
Record the P.U value in your test sheet.

Decrease the injection voltage till the relay reset ( Drop out 
 Value )
Record the D.O value in your test sheet
Increase the voltage again to (P.U) value.
Stop the test set.
Restart the test set (with Voltage = P.U value).

The relay will operate, the timer will account and stop when 
 the trip contact close.

Make sure that lock out relays (86GT & 86T) operate with Under 
 Voltage relay operate after its trip time.
Record the time value in your test sheet.

Make reset to the under voltage relay and lock out relays 
 (86GT & 86T).
Put C.B of the unit at local position.
Close C.B of the unit.
Return C.B of the unit to remote position.

Trip C.B of the unit by Over Voltage Relay by increasing the 
 injection voltage to the pickup value.
Stop the tester.

Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service

items:
Make reset to Over Voltage Relay, 
 alarm indication and lockout relays (86GT&86T).
Disconnect the test leads from the Relay.

Reconnect 
 the relay terminals points (10,11) to its normal position
